name: Markwayne Mullin

offices.t: United States Secretary of Homeland Security

summary:
Markwayne Mullin (born July 26, 1977) is an American politician and businessman who has served as the 9th United States secretary of homeland security since 2026. A member of the Republican Party, Mullin served from 2023 to 2026 as the junior United States senator from Oklahoma and from 2013 to 2023 as the U.S. representative for Oklahoma's second congressional district.
A member of the Cherokee Nation, Mullin assumed control of his family's plumbing business in 1998.
